items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I played with Manuel. I played with him about, say about a year or something, him and Vic, old Gaspar.

ctx.x: But you know he used to drink though, didn't he? He does so. Yeah, he used to, he come to wakes right here, stop right there. And he will spend his money on it. Yeah. He'll get a half a pint of a pint, get it there. And he say and give him, what they call again, some, is it setting up or something he wants to chase him. Yeah, yeah. He'll stand up right there and drink every bit of it. And he step up another fella drinking, he stand up right there and go home just as sober as me or you. I'm telling you, I see him…
You can't tell what's going to kill you.

items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: I started playing with all the boys, I played with Mal Perez

ctx.x: I haven't seen him for a long time, well, he's been back, he went to, New Iberic, but he's back, he wasn't made up, a little band over there, but they tell me he's back now, he's trying to sing, yeah, so, nevertheless, see, and I started playing guitar, and I started playing with all the boys, I played with Mal Perez, well, we was all, good ones, and after, 1917, all I thought, as Bud Scott, the Sharma, well, he said, there you go, they give me, plenty of good leads, I'm gonna say that, and, of course, I take…
I don't know him, but I know he's out, well, yeah,
